channel.title: GigaMail blog
channel.description: Notes from building an email agent you can trust: one problem per article, with the numbers.

item.title: A link preview sent data out before anyone approved the draft
item.description: Telegram fetches the first link of a message from its own servers to build a preview. A draft written by an agent that read a hostile mail can use that to send data out before you tap anything. How it works and what we changed.

item.title: Hiding invisible text from an email agent withheld 28% of real mail
item.description: An email can say one thing to you and another to your AI agent. We made the agent read only what a person sees, and more than one HTML mail in four went missing. What was in the way, and how it came down to 6%.
